verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents adjacent building blocks — bank reconciliation tools and APIs, accountant invite/collaboration for journal entries and reconciliation, an audit trail, custom reports, and workflow triggers — and a customer testimonial mentions 'month-end closures' being reduced via MCP automation. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated close checklist feature that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs as an integrated workflow. Missing for 10: a documented close-checklist/task-tracking feature, accrual-tracking within a structured close workflow, explicit sign-off/approval tracking for reviewers.
